step.action: Complete 📋 Clean_bar if the bar top is not clean and dry.
Read the current music, wine, and cheese pairing on 🍷 Pairing_List.
Place one lined trash bin at each side of 🍷 Bar.
Put the required ice in 🍷 Wine_Cooler.
step.ifThen: IF the wine is Pinot Noir, THEN use 2 bags. IF it is white, rosé, or sparkling red, THEN use 5 bags. IF the required ice is unavailable, THEN complete 📋 Get_camp_ice.

step.action: Put the Wine of the Day cans in 🍷 Wine_Cooler.
step.ifThen: IF the Wine of the Day is unavailable, THEN tell the Bar Lead.

passWhen.criterion: The bar top is clean and dry.
One lined trash bin is on each side of the bar.
The cooler contains the Wine of the Day and the correct number of ice bags.
The worker can state the current music, wine, and cheese pairing.

reasoning.entry: The workbook phrase about two trash bags is interpreted as two total, one at each side, because that is the smallest arrangement matching the wording.
